thesis: The morning thesis is unchanged. Palomar is a profitable specialty P&C insurer with revenue up 58% YoY to 386.6M, net income up 27% and improving, and a forward P/E of 13.7. It has now held the Nov 5 earnings gap for 7 sessions, and as a low-beta (0.24) financials name it sits in a leading sector (XLF) of a risk-off tape. Intraday it tagged a new 52-week high of 162.38 and faded to 159.82 (15-min delayed), just above the 155.5-159.0 zone. RSI is 71.0 and price is 8.3% above SMA20, so this stays a pullback-only entry. Zone R/R is about 2.8 (mid 157.25). At the last price R/R is about 1.7: (175.0-159.82)/(159.82-150.9). News and SEC feeds were available. There was no debate this session because pre-close does not run one, not because the setup is weak.
invalidation: A daily close below 151.5 (the Nov 6 gap-hold low), with a close under the 20-day SMA near 147.6 confirming the post-earnings breakout has failed.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (QQQ below its 50/200-day averages, ^TNX 5.141 at the 0.914 percentile) could drag momentum names regardless of sector
